King's Recruit#002.src: You three are going to make fine soldiers. Now, go on to {p}, the King is awaiting your arrival.
King's Recruit#002.dst: Vocês três serão ótimos soldados. Agora, sigam para {p}, o Rei aguarda a chegada de vocês.

King's Recruit#003.src: Well, what are we waiting for?

King's Recruit#006.src: Hey, {u}! You alright in there? Looks like we hit something.
King's Recruit#006.dst: Ei, {u}! Tudo bem aí dentro? Parece que batemos em algo.

King's Recruit#007.src: Hey, {u}! Are you alright in there? It looks like we've hit something.
King's Recruit#007.dst: Ei, {u}! Você está bem aí dentro? Parece que batemos em alguma coisa.

King's Recruit#008.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#008.dst: Saia da caravana e fale com o condutor da caravana em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#009.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#009.dst: Saia da caravana e fale com o condutor em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#010.src: Hm... I swear I hit this same darn boulder every time I make this trip. Sorry folks.
King's Recruit#010.dst: Hm... Juro que bato nessa pedra maldita toda viagem. Foi mal, pessoal.
King's Recruit#010.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#011.src: Ah. Does this mean we have to walk all the way to {p} from here?
King's Recruit#011.dst: Ah. Quer dizer que vamos ter que andar daqui até {p}?
King's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#012.src: Unfortunately so. Luckily, it's not that far from here. Just a straight path forward.
King's Recruit#012.dst: Infelizmente, sim. Por sorte, não é tão longe. É só seguir reto pela estrada.
King's Recruit#012.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#013.src: Well, nothing to do but keep moving! Tasim, {u}, I'll race you to the gate!
King's Recruit#013.dst: Bem, o jeito é continuar! Tasim, {u}, aposto corrida até o portão!
King's Recruit#013.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#015.src: ... He's already gone. We'll have to catch up to him. {u}, lead the way.
King's Recruit#015.dst: ... Ele já foi. Vamos ter que alcançá-lo. {u}, vá na frente.
King's Recruit#015.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#016.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#016.dst: Siga o caminho até o portão da província de Wynn em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#017.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#017.dst: Siga o caminho até o portão da província de Wynn em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#018.src: I don't suppose you know much about Wynn either, do you?
King's Recruit#018.dst: Imagino que você também não saiba muito sobre Wynn, né?
King's Recruit#018.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#019.src: Of course, the King of {p}'s been recruiting Fruma soldiers, but...
King's Recruit#019.dst: Claro, o Rei de {p} anda recrutando soldados de Fruma, mas...
King's Recruit#019.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#020.src: That war of theirs must be getting pretty bad if they need this much support.
King's Recruit#020.dst: Essa guerra deles deve estar bem feia se precisam de tanto apoio.
King's Recruit#020.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#021.src: Oh, there's Aledar! And the gate, by the looks of it.
King's Recruit#021.dst: Ah, lá está o Aledar! E o portão, pelo jeito.
King's Recruit#021.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#022.src: There you two are! You'll have to be faster than that if you want to stand a chance against the undead.
King's Recruit#022.dst: Aí estão vocês! Vão ter que ser mais rápidos se quiserem ter chance contra os mortos-vivos.
King's Recruit#022.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#023.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time.
King's Recruit#023.dst: Tá, tá, da próxima vez corremos.
King's Recruit#023.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#024.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time. So, is this the gate marking the border between Wynn and Fruma?
King's Recruit#024.dst: Tá, tá, da próxima vez corremos. Então, este é o portão na fronteira entre Wynn e Fruma?
King's Recruit#024.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#025.src: It looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#025.dst: Parece que sim! Prontos para o começo das nossas novas vidas?
King's Recruit#025.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#026.src: Looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#026.dst: Parece que sim! Vocês dois estão prontos pra começar nossa nova vida?
King's Recruit#026.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#027.src: {u}, why don't you do the honours? Go ahead and open that gate.
King's Recruit#027.dst: {u}, que tal fazer as honras? Vá em frente e abra esse portão.
King's Recruit#027.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#028.src: Enter the Province of Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#028.dst: Entre na província de Wynn em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#029.src: Enter the Province of Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#029.dst: Entre na província de Wynn em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#030.src: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go ahead and explore this province.
King's Recruit#030.dst: Bem, o que estamos esperando? Vamos explorar esta província.
King's Recruit#030.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#031.src: Continue through the Wynn Province to the castle
King's Recruit#031.dst: Siga pela província de Wynn até o castelo

King's Recruit#032.src: So this is Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#032.dst: Então esta é a Wynn de que tanto ouvimos falar... É linda.
King's Recruit#032.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#033.src: So this is the Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#033.dst: Então esta é a Wynn de que tanto ouvimos falar... É linda.
King's Recruit#033.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#034.src: I guess the war hasn't made it this far. This is what we'll be fighting to protect.
King's Recruit#034.dst: Acho que a guerra não chegou até aqui. É isto que vamos lutar para proteger.
King's Recruit#034.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#035.src: Hey, recruits! Come over here, I have something to tell you.
King's Recruit#035.dst: Ei, recrutas! Venham cá, tenho algo para dizer.
King's Recruit#035.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#038.src: A soldier? What are you doing all the way out here?
King's Recruit#038.dst: Um soldado? O que faz tão longe assim?
King's Recruit#038.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#039.src: There's a bit of trouble up ahead. They sent me out here to intercept new recruits.
King's Recruit#039.dst: Há problemas mais à frente. Me mandaram aqui para interceptar novos recrutas.
King's Recruit#039.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#040.src: If you want to survive out here, you're going to need this.
King's Recruit#040.dst: Se querem sobreviver aqui fora, vão precisar disto.
King's Recruit#040.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#043.src: Hopefully we won't have to use these just yet.
King's Recruit#043.dst: Tomara que não precisemos usar isto ainda.
King's Recruit#043.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#044.src: Good luck out there, recruits! Just follow this path, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#044.dst: Boa sorte aí fora, recrutas! Sigam este caminho e mais à frente haverá uma ponte.
King's Recruit#044.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#045.src: Just follow this path straight forward, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#045.dst: Sigam este caminho em frente e mais adiante haverá uma ponte.
King's Recruit#045.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#048.src: Ah, this must be the bridge the soldier was talking about. But it certainly looks very...
King's Recruit#048.dst: Ah, essa deve ser a ponte de que o soldado falou. Mas ela parece bem...
King's Recruit#048.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#049.src: Well, let's not keep the King of {p} waiting!
King's Recruit#049.dst: Vamos, o Rei de {p} nos espera!
King's Recruit#049.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#053.src: That's what I was trying to warn you about! Let's just get off this bridge before the rest of it collapses...
King's Recruit#053.dst: Era disso que eu tentava te avisar! Vamos sair desta ponte antes que o resto desabe...
King's Recruit#053.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#054.src: Well, how are we meant to get to the other side of this ravine now? Ugh. Another thing gone wrong, just like-...
King's Recruit#054.dst: E como vamos chegar ao outro lado deste desfiladeiro agora? Argh. Mais uma coisa dando errado, igual a-...
King's Recruit#054.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#056.src: That's... weird. I was just thinking about something from before Wynn, but... it's gone. I can't remember.
King's Recruit#056.dst: Que... estranho. Eu pensava em algo de antes de Wynn, mas... sumiu. Não consigo lembrar.
King's Recruit#056.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#057.src: Hm. I can't remember anything from Fruma either... {u}, how about you?
King's Recruit#057.dst: Hm. Também não lembro de nada de Fruma... {u}, e você?
King's Recruit#057.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#058.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#058.dst: Nada. Não pode ser coincidência todos perdermos a memória juntos, né?
King's Recruit#058.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#059.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we've all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#059.dst: Nada. Não pode ser coincidência todos perdermos a memória ao mesmo tempo, né?
King's Recruit#059.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#060.src: No, but... We can worry about that later. For now, we need to find a way past this ravine. Aledar, {u}, you should look around for a way across. I'll keep looking here.
King's Recruit#060.dst: Não, mas... Podemos nos preocupar com isso depois. Agora, precisamos atravessar este desfiladeiro. Aledar, {u}, procurem um caminho por aí. Vou continuar olhando aqui.
King's Recruit#060.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#062.src: Search for another way across the ravine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#062.dst: Procure outro jeito de atravessar o desfiladeiro em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#063.src: Find another way across the ravine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#063.dst: Encontre outro jeito de atravessar o desfiladeiro em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#064.src: Woah! That sure did the trick, {u}. Good thinking!
King's Recruit#064.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#065.src: Hey, Tasim! Come over here, {u} found a way over!
King's Recruit#065.dst: Ei, Tasim! Vem cá, {u} achou um caminho!
King's Recruit#065.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#068.src: Phew! We made it over safely this time at least.
King's Recruit#068.dst: Ufa! Pelo menos dessa vez passamos inteiros.
King's Recruit#068.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#069.src: If we just continue forward, we should make it to {p} in no time!
King's Recruit#069.dst: Se seguirmos em frente, chegaremos a {p} rapidinho!
King's Recruit#069.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#070.src: Hmm? What's that guard doing here? We should probably talk to them if we want to pass through.
King's Recruit#070.dst: Hmm? O que esse guarda faz aqui? Melhor falar com ele se quisermos passar.
King's Recruit#070.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#071.src: Hm? What's that guard doing here? We should probably talk to them if we want to pass through.
King's Recruit#071.dst: Hm? O que esse guarda faz aqui? Melhor falar com ele se quisermos passar.
King's Recruit#071.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#076.src: A group of corrupted have sieged this underpass. I can't let you enter without any armour.
King's Recruit#076.dst: Corrompidos cercaram esta passagem. Não posso deixar vocês entrarem sem armadura.
King's Recruit#076.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#077.src: Then what do we do? We have to get to {p}!
King's Recruit#077.dst: E agora? Temos que chegar a {p}!
King's Recruit#077.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#078.src: Do you see that cave over there? Caves such as those often contain useful loot that can help keep you alive.
King's Recruit#078.dst: Veem aquela caverna ali? Cavernas assim costumam ter saque útil que ajuda a manter vocês vivos.
King's Recruit#078.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#079.src: If you enter the cave, you should be able to find some armour to protect you. After that return to me.
King's Recruit#079.dst: Se entrarem na caverna, devem achar alguma armadura para se proteger. Depois, voltem a mim.
King's Recruit#079.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#080.src: What do you say {u}? Let's go see what's in that cave.
King's Recruit#080.dst: O que acha, {u}? Vamos ver o que tem naquela caverna.
King's Recruit#080.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#081.src: Enter the cave and find some armour at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#081.dst: Entre na caverna e encontre uma armadura em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#082.src: Enter the cave and find some armour at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
King's Recruit#082.dst: Entre na caverna e ache armadura em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#083.src: We should return to the guard to see if he'll let us through now!
King's Recruit#083.dst: Devemos voltar ao guarda e ver se ele nos deixa passar agora!
King's Recruit#083.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#084.src: So you found some armor, huh?
King's Recruit#084.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#085.src: So you found some armour, huh?
King's Recruit#085.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#086.src: Yes, a helmet! Will you let us pass now?
King's Recruit#086.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#087.src: Hold on there, recruit. Before you can equip a piece of armor you first have to identify it.
King's Recruit#087.dst: Calma aí, recruta. Antes de equipar uma armadura, você precisa identificá-la.
King's Recruit#087.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#088.src: Hold on there, recruit. Before you can equip a piece of armour you first have to identify it.
King's Recruit#088.dst: Calma aí, recruta. Antes de equipar uma armadura, você precisa identificá-la.
King's Recruit#088.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#089.src: And how do we do that?
King's Recruit#089.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#090.src: You can identify items at {#} Item Identifiers. They're found in towns across the whole world, but we have one here for recruits such as yourselves.
King's Recruit#090.dst: Itens são identificados nos {#} Identificadores de itens. Há um em cidades do mundo todo, mas temos um aqui para recrutas como vocês.
King's Recruit#090.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#091.src: Identify your helmet at the Item Identifier and then return to me with it equipped. After you've done that I'll let you pass.
King's Recruit#091.dst: Identifique seu capacete no Identificador de itens e volte a mim com ele equipado. Depois disso, deixo você passar.
King's Recruit#091.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#092.src: Identify your helmet at the {#} Item Identifier and then return to me with it equipped. After you've done that I'll let you pass.
King's Recruit#092.dst: Identifique seu capacete no {#} Identificador de itens e volte a mim com ele equipado. Depois disso, deixo você passar.
King's Recruit#092.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#093.src: I see you have your helmet on. Fantastic, you may now pass. Let me open this door for you.
King's Recruit#093.dst: Vejo que está de capacete. Ótimo, podem passar. Vou abrir esta porta para vocês.
King's Recruit#093.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#094.src: I see you have your helmet on. Fantastic, you may now pass. Let me open this for you.
King's Recruit#094.dst: Vejo que está de capacete. Ótimo, podem passar. Vou abrir para vocês.
King's Recruit#094.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#095.src: Good luck in there recruits! Even with your armour it won't be so easy!
King's Recruit#095.dst: Boa sorte aí dentro, recrutas! Nem com armadura vai ser fácil!
King's Recruit#095.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#096.src: Good luck in there, recruits! Even with your new armour, it's not going to be so easy!
King's Recruit#096.dst: Boa sorte aí dentro, recrutas! Nem com a armadura nova vai ser tão fácil!
King's Recruit#096.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#101.src: Wow, that guard wasn't joking. This place is crawling with the corrupt.
King's Recruit#101.dst: Uau, o guarda não brincava. Este lugar está infestado de corrompidos.
King's Recruit#101.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#102.src: That guard wasn't kidding. This place is crawling with the corrupt.
King's Recruit#102.dst: Esse guarda não brincava. Este lugar está infestado de corrompidos.
King's Recruit#102.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#103.src: Well, we've got no choice but to make it through! Finally time for us to use these weapons we got. Let's go, {u}.
King's Recruit#103.dst: Bem, o jeito é passar! Enfim vamos usar as armas que ganhamos. Vamos, {u}.
King's Recruit#103.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#104.src: Finally, time for us to use these weapons we got!
King's Recruit#104.dst: Enfim, hora de usar as armas que ganhamos!

King's Recruit#105.src: {u}, you take the skeleton in the front. We'll handle the two zombies in the back!
King's Recruit#105.dst: {u}, pegue o Skeleton da frente. Nós cuidamos dos dois zumbis lá atrás!
King's Recruit#105.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#108.src: This path opened up, let's continue through the underpass.
King's Recruit#108.dst: Este caminho abriu, vamos seguir pela passagem.

King's Recruit#109.src: Over here! You're just what I needed!
King's Recruit#109.dst: Aqui! Vocês são o que eu precisava!
King's Recruit#109.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#112.src: Finally, some backup! Wait a second... you're straight from Fruma aren't you?
King's Recruit#112.dst: Enfim, reforços! Espera aí... vocês vieram direto de Fruma, não é?
King's Recruit#112.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#113.src: Finally some backup! Wait a second... You're straight from Fruma aren't you?
King's Recruit#113.dst: Enfim, reforços! Espera aí... Vocês vieram direto de Fruma, não é?
King's Recruit#113.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#114.src: Oh well, this area should be clear by now. {p} is just up ahead, after all.
King's Recruit#114.dst: Bom, esta área já deve estar limpa. {p} fica logo ali na frente, afinal.
King's Recruit#114.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#115.src: Oh well, this area should be clear by now. {p} is just up ahead after all.
King's Recruit#115.dst: Bom, esta área já deve estar limpa. {p} fica logo ali na frente, afinal.
King's Recruit#115.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#117.src: Quick, you have to use an ability!
King's Recruit#117.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#118.src: Now cast your spell with your weapon!
King's Recruit#118.dst: Agora lance seu feitiço com a arma!
King's Recruit#118.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#120.src: Wait, it's running away! We have to save the Lieutenant!
King's Recruit#120.dst: Espera, ele está fugindo! Temos que salvar o tenente!
King's Recruit#120.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#122.src: Defeat the Goliath and free the Lieutenant.
King's Recruit#122.dst: Derrote o Goliath e liberte o tenente.

King's Recruit#123.src: ... That was close. Thanks for the save, recruits!
King's Recruit#123.dst: ... Foi por pouco. Valeu pelo resgate, recrutas!

King's Recruit#124.src: That sure was close... Thanks for the save, {u}!
King's Recruit#124.dst: Essa foi por pouco... Valeu por me salvar, {u}!
King's Recruit#124.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#125.src: I think you three are going to make good soldiers - not many can handle themselves like you just did.
King's Recruit#125.dst: Acho que vocês três vão ser bons soldados - poucos se saem como vocês agora.
King's Recruit#125.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#126.src: I think you three are going to make fine soldiers, not many can handle themselves like you just did.
King's Recruit#126.dst: Acho que vocês três serão ótimos soldados, poucos se saem como vocês agora.
King's Recruit#126.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#127.src: It seems that beast dropped something, you should check it out before heading to {p}.
King's Recruit#127.dst: Parece que a fera deixou cair algo, deem uma olhada antes de ir para {p}.

King's Recruit#128.src: It seems that beast dropped something, you should pick it up before heading to {p}.

King's Recruit#129.src: Pick up the loot dropped by the Goliath.
King's Recruit#129.dst: Pegue o saque deixado pelo Goliath.

King's Recruit#130.src: That item looks rare! Maybe there's an identifier around here.
King's Recruit#130.dst: Esse item parece raro! Talvez haja um identificador por aqui.
King's Recruit#130.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#134.src: We... we made it! We really made it! Sure was a close call at the end.
King's Recruit#134.dst: Nós... nós conseguimos! Conseguimos mesmo! Foi por pouco no final.

King's Recruit#141.dst: Aqui está, o fim da nossa jornada.
King's Recruit#141.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#142.src: The end of one adventure, but the beginning of another! Let's go inside and talk to the King!
King's Recruit#142.dst: O fim de uma aventura, mas o começo de outra! Vamos entrar e falar com o Rei!
King's Recruit#142.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#144.dst: Fale com o Rei de {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#145.src: Welcome to the Province of Wynn! By your ragged appearance, I gather your journey here must have been quite the adventure.
King's Recruit#145.dst: Bem-vindos à província de Wynn! Pela aparência maltrapilha, imagino que a viagem até aqui foi uma grande aventura.
King's Recruit#145.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#146.src: This, recruits, is the noble fort of {p}, one of the great cities of our province!
King's Recruit#146.dst: Isto, recrutas, é o nobre forte de {p}, uma das grandes cidades daqui!
King's Recruit#146.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#147.src: This, recruits, is the noble fort of {p}, one of the great cities of our vast province!
King's Recruit#147.dst: Isto, recrutas, é o nobre forte de {p}, uma das grandes cidades da província!
King's Recruit#147.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#148.src: As soldiers of Wynn, it is your duty to stem the tide of corrupted monsters ravaging this land.
King's Recruit#148.dst: Como soldados de Wynn, vocês devem conter os monstros corrompidos que assolam a terra.
King's Recruit#148.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#149.src: Although, you may want to gain some experience beforehand. Many lives are tragically lost every day...
King's Recruit#149.dst: Mas talvez queiram ganhar alguma experiência antes. Muitas vidas se perdem tragicamente todo dia...
King's Recruit#149.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#150.src: Although, you might want to gain some experience beforehand. Many lives are tragically lost every day...
King's Recruit#150.dst: Mas talvez queiram ganhar alguma experiência antes. Muitas vidas se perdem tragicamente todo dia...
King's Recruit#150.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#151.src: Take this [{p} Teleportation Scroll] to aid you in your journey. Upon use, it will instantly bring you back to this city, wherever you may be.
King's Recruit#151.dst: Levem este {c2}[Pergaminho de Teletransporte de {p}]{/} na jornada. Ao usá-lo, vocês voltam na hora para esta cidade, estejam onde estiverem.
King's Recruit#151.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#152.src: With that, I must bid you farewell, more recruits may arrive at any time. Good luck out there, soldiers of Wynn!
King's Recruit#152.dst: Dito isso, devo me despedir, mais recrutas podem chegar a qualquer momento. Boa sorte, soldados de Wynn!
King's Recruit#152.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#153.src: So! Wynn, huh? It's pretty exciting to finally be here.
King's Recruit#153.dst: Então! Wynn, hein? Que emoção enfim estar aqui.
King's Recruit#153.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#154.src: I can't wait to discover what it looks like for myself!
King's Recruit#154.dst: Mal posso esperar para ver como é de perto!
King's Recruit#154.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#155.src: Ha, well, I think I'm going to head in the direction of {p} soon, although there seems to be something called {p} on the way...
King's Recruit#155.dst: Ha, bem, acho que logo vou rumo a {p}, embora pareça haver algo chamado {p} no caminho...
King's Recruit#155.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#156.src: Ha, well, I think I'm going to head in the direction of {p} soon, although there appears to be something called {p} on the way...
King's Recruit#156.dst: Ha, bem, acho que logo vou rumo a {p}, embora pareça haver algo chamado {p} no caminho...
King's Recruit#156.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#157.src: Enough talking already! Let's get out there and help some people!
King's Recruit#157.dst: Chega de conversa! Vamos lá fora ajudar as pessoas!
King's Recruit#157.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#158.src: And he's gone again... Well, I'm sure we'll be seeing more of him soon enough.
King's Recruit#158.dst: E lá se foi ele de novo... Bem, com certeza vamos vê-lo de novo logo.
King's Recruit#158.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#159.src: It's beautiful... Oh! I almost forgot to tell you, {u}.
King's Recruit#159.dst: É lindo... Ah! Quase esqueci de te contar, {u}.
King's Recruit#159.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#160.src: There's this handy item we were all given on our way here, the Content Book. It displays most things you can do in this world; Quests, Caves, and much, much more.
King's Recruit#160.dst: Todos recebemos um item útil no caminho, o Livro de Conteúdo. Ele mostra quase tudo o que dá para fazer no mundo: Missões, Cavernas e muito mais.
King's Recruit#160.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#161.src: It also lets you track any content you want, which will create beacons for you to follow.
King's Recruit#161.dst: Ele também rastreia o conteúdo que quiser, criando sinalizadores para você seguir.
King's Recruit#161.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#162.src: Here, why don't you try it out? Use your Content Book and click on the highlighted quest.
King's Recruit#162.dst: Que tal experimentar? Use seu livro de conteúdo e clique na missão destacada.
King's Recruit#162.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#163.src: There you go! I'm going to head towards {p}, at the end of the {p}.
King's Recruit#163.dst: Isso aí! Vou na direção de {p}, no fim de {p}.
King's Recruit#163.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#164.src: You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u}.
King's Recruit#164.dst: Me encontre lá quando estiver um pouco mais forte. Bem, até mais, {u}.
King's Recruit#164.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#165.src: There you go! I'm going to head towards {p}, at the end of the {p}. You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger.
King's Recruit#165.dst: Isso aí! Vou na direção de {p}, no fim de {p}. Me encontre lá quando estiver um pouco mais forte.
King's Recruit#165.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#167.src: What are you waiting for recruits? Go identify your helmet at the  Item Identifier and then equip it in your helmet slot!
King's Recruit#167.dst: Estão esperando o quê, recrutas? Vão identificar seu elmo no  Identificador de Itens e depois equipem no espaço de elmo!

King's Recruit#168.src: Unless you'd rather stand around here all day, that's fine by me too.
King's Recruit#168.dst: Ou podem ficar aqui parados o dia todo, por mim tudo bem.

King's Recruit#169.src: Well, what are you waiting for?

King's Recruit#170.src: Good luck in there, recruits. You're gonna need it...
King's Recruit#170.dst: Boa sorte aí dentro, recrutas. Vão precisar...
King's Recruit#170.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#171.src: We did it! Let's continue through the underpass.
King's Recruit#171.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#172.src: Well? Let's go see what this province is really like.
King's Recruit#172.dst: E aí? Vamos ver como é esta província.
King's Recruit#172.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#173.src: It's beautiful... It's pretty exciting to finally be here, don't you think?
King's Recruit#173.dst: É lindo... Que emoção finalmente estar aqui, não acha?
King's Recruit#173.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#174.src: There's no use standing around here waiting for adventure to come to us! I'm getting out there and helping some people!
King's Recruit#174.dst: Não adianta ficar parado esperando a aventura vir até nós! Vou lá fora ajudar as pessoas!
King's Recruit#174.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#175.src: Oh! I almost forgot to tell you, {u}. There's this handy item we were given, the Content Book. It displays most things you can do in this world and lets you track them, creating beacons for you to follow.
King's Recruit#175.dst: Ah! Quase esqueci de te contar, {u}. Ganhamos um item útil, o livro de conteúdo. Ele mostra quase tudo o que dá pra fazer neste mundo e permite rastrear, criando sinalizadores para você seguir.
King's Recruit#175.speaker: Tasim
